It maintains a polite and empathetic tone and does not promise unsupported outcomes. Variant B is empathetic and encourages contacting support but is less specific and less proactive than A. Variant C is factually correct and directs the customer to official secure channels, which is appropriate given the severity and repeated failures reported; it is more formal and less empathetic, but escalation to human review is justified due to the unresolved serious product and service issues.
